title: THE TEAMMATE ROWS STAY ON THE LEFT
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-08, in v19.07: the co-op teammate rows started under the pillager board wherever it had been dragged, so a board moved to the right or low on the screen pushed your teammate health and DOWN countdown under the controls list or off the bottom. They follow the board only when it sits over their own left column, and fall back to their old place when they would not fit.
now: Your teammate rows stay readable at the left wherever you drag the board.
